description: Shared Renovate preset: weekly grouped non-major updates with automerge, individual PRs for majors and 0.x minors; GitHub Actions pinned via actions.lock

packageRules.description: Use the actions lockfile (.github/workflows/actions.lock, gh actions-lock) instead of inline digest pins
Group all non-major updates into one weekly PR and automerge it when CI passes
0.x minor updates may be breaking: keep them out of the automerged group
Lock file maintenance refreshes already-published versions; no cooldown needed

customManagers.description: Track the gh-actions-lock version used to verify the actions lockfile
